note: Hosts and URL shapes that place real-money orders. Data hosts, paper and sandbox hosts are not listed. A command that mentions one of these is refused by the always-on protections (rule real_money). `read_exceptions` is NOT read by that hook: an agent never gets one. It is the list of the only requests Hokma's own backend may make to a listed host (see `hardblock.read_exception_allows`).

read_exceptions.reason: Option contracts and open interest, read only (SPEC-014)
